title: Strongly regular graph srg(88, 27, 6, 9)
statement: Find a strongly regular graph with parameters (88, 27, 6, 9): 88 vertices, 27-regular, adjacent vertices with exactly 6 common neighbours and non-adjacent vertices with exactly 9. It is the smallest parameter set marked open in A. E. Brouwer's tables. A valid graph scores 1.
submission: Text file: the graph in graph6 or sparse6 (as on House of Graphs), as an edge list (one edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered from 0) or as a 0/1 adjacency matrix.
score: 1 for a valid graph; none is known, so the best known value is 0

best_known.source: existence unknown: A. E. Brouwer's table of strongly regular graphs on 51-100 vertices marks (88, 27, 6, 9) with '?', and no parameter set on 1-50 vertices is open; read 9 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: A. E. Brouwer, Parameters of strongly regular graphs
provenance.revision: tables for 1-50 and 51-100 vertices read 9 Nov 2026
